row:
If you're looking for safe pelvic floor exercises and want to know how to do Kegel exercises correctly, you're in the right place!

Hi, I’m Michelle, a Pelvic Health Physio, here to help guide and support you with evidence-based pelvic floor exercises and pelvic floor safe strength and fitness exercises that you can relate to and trust.

Whether you’re:
- Looking to strengthen your pelvic floor and core muscles 
- Dealing with bladder or bowel problems
- Living with prolapse problems
- Suffering from erectile dysfunction
- Recovering after prostate surgery
- Exercising after hysterectomy

This channel is here with reliable Pelvic Floor Physio information — no matter who you are, where you live, or your life circumstances.

Access to quality pelvic health information is your right — and everyone’s birthright.

Let's exercise together to help you feel better — inside and out.
